reviews.title: It should say you need to pay to use it
reviews.text: After you go through all the trouble to download the app etc, in order to use it you need to pay. Why dont you say it before download?!, so we go the next app that does the same for free?

reviews.title: Pay to win
reviews.text: Very useful most of the time but, only allows you to take 3 photos a day without a subscription use Google Translate instead this is probably the WORST APP I’ve downloaded change the darn limit😑

reviews.title: Useless app
reviews.text: Photos are so blurry. The lens won't focus so you have to hold the text you want to translate really far away. And you get about 3 tries before it forces you to pay

reviews.title: Ugh
reviews.text: Every time they update this application, it gets worse. It’s a shame it’s not like it used to be.
